name: @cotal-ai/connector-hermes
description: Cotal connector for the Hermes (Nous Research) agent.

scripts.test: tsx smoke/tool-parity.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/agui-map.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/kickoff-turn.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/agent-commands.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/operator-reply.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/operator-commands.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/approvals.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/plugin-approvals.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/models.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/effort.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/clarify.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/stream.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/bridge-quiet.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/launch-env.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/adapter-contract.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/reconnect-effect.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/bundle-import.smoke.ts
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && pnpm run bundle && node ../../scripts/plugin-manifest.mjs
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/launch.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/launch.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/standalone.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=plugin/cotal/_sidecar/standalone.cjs --define:import.meta.dirname=__dirname && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../connector-core/src/docs-index.bin','dist/docs-index.bin')" && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../connector-core/src/docs-bundle.bin','dist/docs-bundle.bin')" && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../connector-core/src/docs-index.bin','plugin/cotal/_sidecar/docs-index.bin')" && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../connector-core/src/docs-bundle.bin','plugin/cotal/_sidecar/docs-bundle.bin')"
